evidence.title: GitHub - pmndrs/jotai: 👻 Primitive and flexible state management for React · GitHub

name: Jotai
summary: Primitive and flexible state management for React built on atoms, with a 2 kB core.
description: A state-management library for React where state lives in atoms: create a primitive atom, read it in components like useState, and derive new atoms from existing ones with get and set — including async and write-only derived atoms. The minimal core API is about 2 kB, comes with utilities and extensions, and avoids string keys. Scales from a useState replacement to enterprise TypeScript applications.
contains: minimal core API of about 2 kB
primitive, derived, async and write-only atoms
no string keys, compared to Recoil
docs and a course linked from the repo
